newsitem.title: SWITZERLAND: Swiss 3-month money market claims yield 1.521 pct.
newsitem.headline: Swiss 3-month money market claims yield 1.521 pct.

text.p: The annual yield on the latest issue of Swiss federal government three-month money market claims is 1.521 percent, unchanged from the previous issue, the Swiss National Bank said.
The latest issue, to be paid for on March 6, raised 805.8 million Swiss francs and was priced at 99.617 percent.
The previous issue, paid for on February 27, raised 1,115.0 million and was also priced at 99.617 percent.
